title: Lucid Dreams - Victims
content: For an uncomfortable while I was having very lucid, vivid dreams where I was being murdered. Each dream I was a separate victim, and the attacks felt so real only I wasn't myself at all. I'm a 38F and I was a young boy in one dream, a young prostitute in another and so on and so forth. I remember having this profound feeling come over me like I must remember all of the details around me. I remember what the building looked like in just one dream (prostitute) - but not the others. It made me feel as if these were unsolved cases and I did try to research the vague visual clues I had from each dream. It was the most intense and lucid dreaming I've ever had. Has this happened to anyone here? I felt compelled to solve/remember... It was like I was a dream detective, which tbh was pretty fucking awesome haha apart from the whole brutal murders & all :0) glad to be here!
